reason: The plugin is best classified as a memory-context tool because its stated purpose is to capture personal moments and thoughts, build a user-centric profile, and generate autobiographical or story-form outputs. Evidence from the repository description and README explicitly frames it as a DeepSeek Harness agent skill for journals/life stories, and package metadata confirms it is a DSH plugin with an execution bundle, so the core user-facing value is personal memory organization and narrative generation.

summaries.zh: BigSeed 是一个用于个人闪念与日记记录的代理技能，可将碎片化内容整理为用户形象并生成小说、剧本或自传式文本。
summaries.en: BigSeed is an agent skill for personal life-note and fleeting-thought capture, helping organize fragments into a user profile and generate story-style outputs like novels, scripts, or autobiographies.

capabilities: Collects life/journal-style user input and organizes it into narrative-oriented content
Generates story-style text outputs (novel, script, autobiography-style writing) via model interaction
Relies on external model API calls for generation
